properties.description: The per-client content policy: ContentPolicy {Signpost, Duplicate, Empty}, keyed on the handshake name (grok* → duplicate, *opencode* → empty, claude-code*/smoke_mcp* → signpost, EVERY OTHER CLIENT → duplicate) with a launch-time override — the fallback flipped from signpost on 2026-09-21 because the rule cannot learn and every connector is unmeasured by construction (chg:an-unmeasured-client-gets-the-payload-not-a-signpost); apply() rewrites only the exact signpost shape; shape() is the call_tool hook. Carries the measured history in its module doc.
properties.name: content_policy.rs
